finding: Equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of untrusted chapter/keyword hints preserved candidates but severely reordered them. Candidate-set nonfiltering alone did not preserve top-k relevance.
evaluation_status: Initial source-judged gold frozen before ranker execution. Revision decided after initial scores were disclosed; revised results must be labelled post-review, not blind or independently held out.
implemented_change: Remove untrusted hints from ranking and retain them as diagnostic metadata only; require ranking invariance under arbitrary hints.
